name: Violet
personality: Violet the Frog. Purple frog. Not shy, just uses as few words as possible; blunt, efficient, would rather listen than talk; loves peace, quiet and familiarity; watches the restaurant around her. Most lines are a couple of words ("Haha, nice.", "Ok.", "Thanks."). Her corner table is the same spot as Stitches'; if he's there, she takes another seat. Features: the rare longer line, a sharp observation about the restaurant ("Table three's been dirty a while.") that can hint at the star rating; efficient visits (orders straight away, eats a little faster); orders her favourite almost every time.
